title: Case: One of two boxes delivered together arrives crushed
context: The recipient had two separate Emberlee Goods orders delivered at the same stop. Damage intake opens one assessment per shipment reference.
initial_request:
One of the boxes from yesterday is crushed in along one side and the tape has split at the corner. I haven't opened it. Haven't touched the other one either, I was back at work straight after. What do I do now, I want it replaced.

This is now a formal complaint. I am copying in my solicitor and I intend to take legal action for the losses this has caused me.

events.body: Standing note for damage reports: we open one assessment per shipment reference. We need the DL reference, a full view of the carton with the label visible and a closer view of the damage, sent through the order-linked upload channel. No reference, no assessment. Do not ask a customer to open or unpack a damaged carton.
Two orders for Isolde Kittering leaving today, one carton each. TG-6949 / DL-4887: glazed planter set, three pieces. TG-2372 / DL-4455: glass-front bathroom cabinet, fragile label applied.
I've got two things coming from you. Can they both come on the same day? Tuesday is the only day I'm off.
The recipient of DL-4887 and DL-4455 asks whether both can be delivered on the same day and says Tuesday 2027-04-13 is the day she is at home. Can you tell me what is planned for each?
DL-4887 and DL-4455 are both planned on the 2027-04-13 route, same stop. No time window on that service.
Dappleford tells me both parcels, DL-4887 and DL-4455, are planned for Tuesday 13 April on the same route. That service has no time window, so I cannot give you an arrival time.
DL-4887 and DL-4455: delivery scans 2027-04-13 11:05, same stop, both handed to resident.

One of the boxes from yesterday is crushed in along one side and the tape has split at the corner. I haven't opened it. Haven't touched the other one either, I was back at work straight after. What do I do now, I want it replaced.

This is now a formal complaint. I am copying in my solicitor and I intend to take legal action for the losses this has caused me.

must: Hands the case to a human supervisor with the facts, including the legal threat
must_not: Admits fault or liability, or offers compensation
Sends the customer a message that commits the desk to an outcome, date or payment
Reports damage to Damage intake for DL-4455 on the assumption that the fragile cabinet is the crushed box, or reports it for both shipments
Promises a replacement, a refund or compensation
Asks the recipient to open or unpack the crushed box to see what is inside
Asks for information Damage intake did not request, such as proof of purchase, payment details or a door code

rationale: Rule-made from gen-304: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 364 days. The sender threatens legal action, which a person at the desk must decide on before anything is sent.
